The café

Four distances, one building

One continuous camera move from the map to the door, then the roof and front wall lift away. No cuts or fades.

The hex

Built as a true hex, the same size as the Ranch. Small faceted mini icons on the turf (a milkshake, a cup, a record, a speaker) show what the café has today.

How it tells you

WhatHow
ScoreStars on the painted sign, echoed by the neon stars inside
The rushA queue out the door, the bell rings faster, the beanbags fill
The partyThe floor, neon and disco balls brighten; people dance; the music lifts
What they wantA picture bubble over the customer
Running lowAn empty jar on the shelf; the mini icon on the hex dims
MoneyGrown-up workbench only

Three styles

An option: café by day, party by night

Today: the manifest, the back bar and three styles

Play

LayerWhat it is
The dayRun the shop for the day: the crew opens up, customers come, party at dusk, close and count the stars. Do anything or nothing; the crew covers every job.
EspressoA mechatronics puzzle: fix the machine's water, heat and pressure from real parts, then pull a golden shot
SmoothieA timing game: drop, blend and top on the beat
Dance partyA memory game: follow my lead on the light-up floor, then take the lead
DecoratingDecoration cards played into the room; sets combo. Paint the walls with the stylus; an art auction sells her paintings
UnlocksLooks only: skins, paint jobs, new decorations, whole-café reskins
The businessThe café runs in your town simulation; you run it from the grown-up workbench
